kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the facts; the pattern/trap/pivot attack structure is a KYP design that does not exist in the source.
kypExtensions.summary: KYP-authored exam-strategy synthesis (station-matching patterns, cofactor traps, type-table pivots, scurvy mini-case with answer autopsy) built on the cited First Aid pages.

The pipeline-as-stations frame: each synthesis step is a station with its cofactor and its disease (hydroxylation = vitamin C = scurvy; triple helix = osteogenesis imperfecta; cross-linking = copper/lysyl oxidase = Menkes), plus the elastin contrast (no hydroxylation station, elastase toll at the end).
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid presents the steps as a numbered list; converting it into a station-to-disease mapping with cofactor pairing is KYP pedagogy.
